title: Crispy Algerian Chicken Tagine Bites
description: A fusion of Japanese and North African flavors in bite-sized crispy chicken nuggets.

ingredients.name: algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a combination of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Cut the chicken breast into small nugget-sized pieces.
In a shallow dish, mix together the all-purpose flour, Algerian spice blend, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate dish, beat the eggs.
In a third dish, place the crispy rice cereal.
Dip each chicken piece into the flour mixture, then the eggs, and finally the crispy rice cereal, pressing gently to adhere.
Place the coated chicken nuggets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with a little bit of oil and sprinkle with chopped ham (if using).
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through and crispy.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
